title: Night shift
question: What does a Turnleaf do when the light goes?
intervention: Watch the patch through one day and night. Tap a Turnleaf at noon and again at night: the inspector shows whether it is using light or sugar.
predictedTradeoff: Switching lets a Turnleaf feed through the night on sugar, but the sugar it drinks is sugar the patch no longer holds; Sunbeads stop making food in the dark.
confounds: Mode changes are counted as records, not Turnleafs: one record stands for every Turnleaf that changed to the same mode in the same tick. Turnleafs and Sunbeads also shade and crowd each other. This is one run.

completion.journalStamp: Watched Turnleafs through a day and a night
